description: Crosswalk from GAGS-HEALTH (HX) requirements to U.S. health-sector law/guidance. status: in-force | nprm-2025-proposed | source-identified. Only in-force HX with executable checks gate conformance; others are roadmap. Not legal advice.

HX-1.note: Binds business associates; platform is a BA when touching ePHI.

HX-5.note: No prescribed fields; data captured and review cadence are risk-driven.

HX-6.note: Hash-chained ledger corroborates ePHI records not improperly altered.

HX-7.citation: 45 CFR 164.514(b)(1) Expert Determination; 164.514(b)(2) Safe Harbor (18 identifiers, (R) catch-all, no-actual-knowledge prong)
HX-7.note: Exactly two lawful methods; LDS is not a third pathway.

HX-8.note: Fail any one criterion -> FDA-regulated device track.

HX-D1.citation: Good Machine Learning Practice — 10 guiding principles (FDA/Health Canada/MHRA, Oct 2021)

HX-D3.citation: AI-Enabled Device Software Functions: Lifecycle Management (DRAFT, Jan 6 2025; non-binding)

HX-9.citation: Jan 6 2025 NPRM — encryption of ePHI at rest and in transit (proposed)
HX-9.note: NOT final as of 2026-06. Forward-looking only.

HX-11.citation: Jan 6 2025 NPRM — technology asset inventory + ePHI network map, reviewed >= every 12 months (proposed)

HX-12.citation: 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11)(iv)(B),(v),(vi); 170.402(b)(4); 170.523(f)(1)(xxi) — 31 predictive source attributes, IRM over 8 characteristics, 4 access capabilities, public disclosure
HX-12.note: In force. USCDI v3 expansion (b)(11)(iii)/(iv) under enforcement discretion to ~2026-02-28 (EDN2025.06).

HX-13.citation: CMS-0057-F (89 FR 8758): 72h/7d timeframes, specific denial reason, public metrics; CMS-4201-F FAQ (2024-02-06) + 42 CFR 422.101(c): algorithm cannot be sole basis, individualized assessment required
HX-13.note: Timeframes/denial-reason in force 2026-01-01 (exclude QHP-FFE and drug PAs); Prior Authorization API effective 2027-01-01 (future).

HX-14.citation: 42 CFR Part 2 (FR Doc 2024-02544): single TPO consent (§2.31/2.33), Notice to Accompany Disclosure (§2.32), proceedings bar (§§2.63-2.64), breach notification (§2.16), provenance over segregation (§2.12(d))
HX-14.note: In force. §2.25 accounting-of-disclosures compliance tolled pending revision of 45 CFR 164.528.

HX-15.citation: SP 800-66 Rev.2 (Feb 2024) HIPAA->CSF v1.1/800-53r5 crosswalk via CPRT; AI RMF 1.0 (4 functions; MEASURE 2.10 Privacy / 2.11 Fairness); AI 600-1 (12 GAI risks; health: Data Privacy, Confabulation, Harmful Bias)
HX-15.note: Voluntary, not law; does not guarantee HIPAA compliance. Implemented as evaluators in server/health-frameworks.mjs. Row-by-row mapping lives in NIST CPRT (consume live).

HX-16.citation: Applied Model Card Draft V0.1 (Nov 2024) schema.xsd — 9 sections incl. KeyMetrics 3 pillars x 6 fields; annotated with 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11) cites
HX-16.note: Voluntary transparency instrument; supports but does not legally satisfy ONC HTI-1. Completeness evaluator in server/health-frameworks.mjs. Draft V0.1 — pin version, watch for successor.

HX-17a.citation: AB 3030 (Health & Safety Code 1339.75-78) GenAI patient-communication disclosure; SB 1120 (Physicians Make Decisions Act) — medical-necessity only by licensed professional, AI cannot deny/delay/modify on medical necessity or rely solely on a group dataset

HX-17b.citation: High-risk AI developer/deployer duties: reasonable care vs algorithmic discrimination, annual impact assessments, consumer notice + appeal, AG disclosure within 90 days; healthcare is a covered consequential decision
HX-17b.note: Delayed from 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-30 by SB25B-004; repeal-and-replace effort reported — re-verify before effective date.

HX-18.citation: High-risk via Annex I (MDR/IVDR conformity route) or Annex III; provider obligations Art. 9-15,17,72 (risk mgmt, data governance, technical documentation, logging, transparency, human oversight, accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity, post-market monitoring)
HX-18.note: Annex III standalone 2026-08-02; Annex I embedded medical 2027-08-02. Digital Omnibus (provisional agreement Nov 2025) would defer to 2027-12-02 (Annex III) / 2028-08-02 (Annex I) but is not yet in the Official Journal — Art. 113 dates remain binding. Implemented as forward-looking controls in server/health-forward-controls.mjs.
